## Checklist
- [ ] `uv run pytest tests/unit -q` passes (offline, no keys)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test
- [ ] README, docs and `CHANGELOG.md` match the change
- [ ] Any published result comes from a real run, with date, model ids and cost (`docs/EVALS.md`)
- [ ] No keys, `.env` contents or private hosts in the diff
